Traditional tale: 神农尝百草

Earlier scenes:
(none)

This scene:
古代的时候有一个人叫神农。他需要当上医，一看别的人就想帮助他们。但是，他有一个问题，他不知道什么东西能做药。神农听说一个远远的地方有一种植物，什么病人吃都会觉得身体更好。神农三个月走去，找到有植物的地方，他看到一个很漂亮的植物，又香又好看。

Expressiveness ideas:
1. After the long journey, add a physical feeling to show its difficulty: “走了三个月以后，他又累又饿。”
2. Make the plant more vivid by describing its flowers: “那种植物开着黄色的、像星星一样的花。”
3. Add his thought when he finds the plant: “神农心想：这也许能帮助很多病人。”

ideas.reason: It is a concrete feeling that fits after walking for three months.
It adds a simple, vivid visual detail without changing the story.
It gives Shen Nong a fitting thought that connects the plant to his wish to help sick people.
